title: Puthoff's EarthTech papers as a guide

tellings.quote: Pudoff, but I I find his work absolutely fascinating. His entire set of papers on his EarthTech website is every is uh acted as a a mentor-type guide to me.

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff has posted a whole set of papers on EarthTech, his research website, and a researcher named Dave Rossi tells Michels these papers have been like a mentor to him. Rossi calls Puthoff's work "absolutely fascinating" and says the papers "acted as a mentor-type guide", though he does not say which papers or what in them taught him most.
